reviews.text: I’ve been going for a year now recommend by a friend of mine and I tried the hair Botox and I’m absolutely in love with the results! Maribel so sweet and anytime I need my hair done she’s available!!! I’m in love! Soft! Shiny! Healthy and my hair has grown so much!

I discovered Beauty Essence when I moved to South Florida five years ago. Anyone who has moved to a new city knows how important that can be. The stylist are familiar with all of the latest techniques while focusing on healthy hair. Highly recommend.

Maribel is my stylist and she does an AMAZING job. All of the stylist are nice and friendly. They treat the customers very good and develop a relationship with their clients. You’ll definitely enjoy the experience and walk out feeling FABULOUS!
